item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs las bsrung ba g.yung drung go khrab
item.coloph: zhes gsang chen seng sgra'i cha lag ma tshangs (tshang) kha skong 'di ltar dgos zhes gter 'byin grub pa'i rgyal po khyab bdag hUM chen bla mas gnang ba brtsal bar gzhi byas/ de dang nye ba don gnyer can 'ga' yis bskul ba yang yang byung bzhin snyoms las blo gros rgya mtshos sug bris byas pa'i yi ge pa ni so bla rnam rgyal tshul khrims kyis bgyis pas dge des zab gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar shog cig/
